title: Machine Learning-Based Detection of Alzheimer's Disease from Handwriting Features
summary: A machine learning project predicting Alzheimer's Disease from DARWIN handwriting features, augmenting a small clinical dataset with synthetic samples before comparing 13 classifiers. It calls SDV's TVAESynthesizer (with SingleTableMetadata) to generate 700 synthetic tabular rows for data augmentation.
evidence: synthesizer = TVAESynthesizer(metadata, epochs = 500); synthesizer.fit(df); synthetic_data = synthesizer.sample(700)
